title: Jubilee Retreat | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Backyard Creek And Outdoor Kitchen- Jubilee Retreat By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Jubilee Retreat by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 109 Grayton Trails Road Details: Jubilee Retreat is a stunning home located on Grayton Trails Road in the sought after village of Grayton Beach located just a kayak or paddle board ride away from the beach. The first floor offers a screened porch area with grill, wet bar and dining area. Just outside of the screened porch you'll find an outdoor living area that you can enjoy at the end of each day. Each floor has a porch to view the beautiful nature surrounding this creekside property. You can paddle kayaks and YOLO boards from the backyard creek access to the Gulf in just a few minutes. Jubilee Retreat is a great place to relax and gather with your friends and family. A short stroll down the quaint Grayton Trails road leads to lots of action! Experience all that Grayton offers from boutique shops to delicious dining options. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Half Mile (5 Minute Bike Ride) -Parking Spaces: 4 Spaces in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 2 -Coffee Maker Available -Gas Grill Available (Propane Provided) -Available For Winter Monthly Rentals- Contact our team with any questions regarding pricing for monthly winter rentals. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 3 Bedrooms / 3.5 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area -Half Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed and Twin Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Media Room with Twin Bed Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
